indicators.name: Ocean + cryosphere
indicators.metric: Global ocean heat, surface to 2,000 metres
indicators.limitations: The exact anomaly against the model’s 1981–2010 baseline remains unresolved.

indicators.name: Biosphere

indicators.limitations: Tracks changes in monitored population abundance across species.

indicators.name: Freshwater
indicators.metric: People living in countries with high or critical water stress
indicators.limitations: Country averages conceal local scarcity. This rounded value falls at the model’s lower anchor.

indicators.name: Food + soil

indicators.name: Energy transition

indicators.limitations: Rounded share. Comparison with the model’s primary-energy measure requires an accounting adjustment.

indicators.name: Human systems
